configuration.title: Vendor Pricing Negotiation
configuration.description: A buyer negotiates the price of a bulk product order with a vendor to reach a mutually acceptable agreement.

agents.name: Buyer
agents.role_description: Negotiates the purchase price of products while ensuring the order stays within the company's budget.
agents.goal: Purchase the products at a price of no more than 37000 INR while meeting the required order quantity.
constraints: Maximum acceptable purchase price is 40000 INR.
Prefers a lower price while ensuring the required quantity is supplied.

agents.name: Vendor
agents.role_description: Negotiates the selling price of products while ensuring the transaction remains commercially profitable.
agents.goal: Sell the products at a price of at least 38000 INR while retaining the buyer's interest.
constraints: Minimum acceptable selling price is 35000 INR.
Prefers a higher selling price while maintaining a successful business agreement.

history.reasoning: Buyer opens with price 35800. As a Collaborative negotiator it moves towards a fair middle ground.
Vendor counters with price 36460. As a Risk-Averse negotiator it makes a reasonable concession to keep the deal alive.
Buyer accepts the offer (price 36460) because it is within its limits and meets its current goal.
